# Affinity

Affinity helps private capital investors to find, manage, and close more deals

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/affinity/.

## Actions

- **Get all companies** (read-only): Affinity api allows paginated access to company info and custom fields.
- **Get a company s list entries** (read-only): Summarize company data across all lists, including list-specific fields and metadata like creation date and author.
- **Get a company s lists** (read-only): Returns metadata for all the lists on which the given company appears.
- **Get a person s list entries** (read-only): Summary.
- **Get a person s lists** (read-only): Returns metadata for all the lists on which the given person appears.
- **Get a single company** (read-only): Retrieve basic company info and specific field data by using fieldids or fieldtypes parameters.
- **Get a single opportunity** (read-only): Get basic details about an opportunity without field data via provided endpoints.
- **Get a single person** (read-only): Use get /v2/persons/fields with fieldids or fieldtypes for detailed data.
- **Get all list entries on a list** (read-only): Access and export essential data and metadata for companies, persons, or opportunities from a list, specifying data via fieldids or…
- **Get all list entries on a saved view** (read-only): Use the endpoint to access rows in a saved view with specific filters and selected fields from a web app.
- **Get all opportunities** (read-only): Pagination through opportunities in affinity yields basic info but excludes field data.
- **Get all persons** (read-only): The affinity api offers paginated access to person data using fieldids or fieldtypes.
- **Get current user** (read-only): Returns metadata about the current user.
- **Get metadata on a single list** (read-only): Returns metadata on a single list.
- **Get metadata on a single list s fields** (read-only): Returns metadata on the fields available on a single list.
- **Get metadata on a single saved view** (read-only): Returns metadata on a single saved view.
- **Get metadata on all lists** (read-only): Returns metadata on lists.
- **Get metadata on company fields** (read-only): Returns metadata on non-list-specific company fields.
- **Get metadata on person fields** (read-only): Returns metadata on non-list-specific person fields.
- **Get metadata on saved views** (read-only): Returns metadata on the saved views on a list.
